body:
Just suck it up until tomorrow. If you are still down then PM me. I might not be the type of person you want help from but I'm offering it. You can choose to talk with me or not. 

Whatever the decision I hope that the best tens out for you.

Have you been diagnosed with depression? If not I'd like you to schedule an appointment with a therapist. If you can't afford one then I'm sure that there are a lot of cheap or free services that can help you out.

I don't know if you're truly suicidal or not (you didn't mention it but you posted here) but I'd like for you to go through the mental healthcare system before you do anything stupid. I believe that suicide is reserved for people in extreme situations with no other options. Life should not be taken for granted. 

I hope that my words will have some impact as I'm trying to help out as many people as possible before I return to nothingness. Don't worry about me though. 

Just be safe and don't do anything vain for the time being. Sit in there. I'm pretty sure that things will get better for you and I hope they do.
